title: Diplomatic Revival: Navigating the US-Iran Nuclear Negotiation
description: Iran and the United States are set to resume nuclear negotiations in Turkey, involving regional players like Saudi Arabia and Egypt. Amidst heightened tensions, the talks aim to address disputes over Iran's nuclear program. Both nations explore diplomatic avenues against the backdrop of military developments and regional dynamics.
